Full session blocks worth planning your day around: Contributed Oral/Poster Session "buckets" with an aquatic title, plus Symposia, Special Sessions, Organized Oral Sessions, Workshops, and Inspire Sessions with substantial aquatic content.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

df <- read_csv("data/highlevel.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

fmt <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html"

k <- kbl(df, format = fmt, booktabs = TRUE,
         longtable = (fmt == "latex"), align = "l",
         caption = paste0("Total sessions found: ", nrow(df)))

if (fmt == "latex") {
  k <- k |>
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header", "hold_position"),
      stripe_color = "gray!10",
      font_size = 9
    ) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "0.7in") |>
    column_spec(2, width = "1.0in") |>
    column_spec(3, width = "1.0in") |>
    column_spec(4, width = "1.5in") |>
    column_spec(5, width = "4.0in") |>
    column_spec(6, width = "1.0in")
} else {
  k <- k |>
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = TRUE
    )
}

k
```
